comparison.objective: Carry a bottom-opening carton of cans to a shelf without losing its contents.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual support from below, load stabilization, transport, and shelf placement.
comparison.success_condition: No can may leave the carton; the carton must rest upright within the shelf boundary, released and still for 1 second.
comparison.reason: Payload support and transport are unrelated to connector-cavity tooling and retained-terminal extraction.
